dct_title_s: Satellite detected landslide extent in Mogitu & Ganana Ward, Hanang District, Tanzania as of 19 December 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: LS20231208TZA** This map illustrates satellite detected landslides in Hanang District, Manyara Region, Tanzania as observed from a Sentinel-2 acquired on 19 December 2023 at 11:01 local time. Within the analyzed area of 5,800 ha, about 55 ha of mudflow scars are observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
